What is UltraClear®?

UltraClear® is an advanced laser system that rejuvenates your skin by creating controlled, microscopic channels. These microchannels activate the skin’s natural healing process, promoting collagen production, enhancing texture, and restoring a vibrant, youthful glow. The precision and versatility of UltraClear® allow customized treatments that cater specifically to your skincare needs.

Frequently Asked Questions for Cincinnati & Dayton Patients

How Many UltraClear® Treatments Will I Need?

Most patients experience significant improvement after one treatment, though a series of 2-3 sessions spaced about 4-6 weeks apart often yields optimal results.

How Should I Prepare for UltraClear® Treatment?

Avoid direct sun exposure for 3-4 weeks before and after treatment to ensure optimal results. Discontinue exfoliating skincare products one week prior to your session.

What Should I Expect After UltraClear® Treatment?

Most patients experience minimal discomfort. Mild redness or slight swelling typically resolves within hours, allowing you to quickly return to normal activities.

  • 3DMIRACL™ Sessions: Mild redness resolves within hours, no downtime required.
  • Customized Deeper Treatments: Mild redness or swelling may persist up to 24 hours but quickly resolves, revealing healthier, rejuvenated skin.
